user.title: Cloud connection settings
user.description: Advanced setup: provide your authorized Fluval cloud broker instance and client credentials. These are not your Fluval account password. No manufacturer credentials are bundled with this integration. See the repository setup guide before continuing.

account.title: Verify your Fluval account
account.description: Sign in to identify lights belonging to your EU-region account. Your password and account token are used once and are not saved. Fluval may sign out another app session.

device.title: Choose your aquarium
device.description: Only Aquasky 3.0 lights returned by your account can be selected. Setup performs a read-only status check.

error.invalid_connection: Check the broker instance ID and client credentials.
error.invalid_auth: Fluval did not accept the account sign-in.
error.cannot_connect: Could not read live status securely. Check connectivity, region and connection settings.

abort.device_not_verified: The aquarium has not been verified through its owner account.
abort.no_supported_devices: No supported Aquasky 3.0 Wi-Fi lights were returned by this EU account.
